title: Assistant Professor in Thermal Engineering with a Focus on Electronics Cooling in Early Component Design
description:
Fixed-term full-time position (4 years), to be filled from 1 November 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter, at the Aalborg campus.

If you want to contribute to the next generation of high-power electronic components by integrating thermal design directly into the early stages of technology and component development, this position may be the right opportunity for you. We are looking for an Assistant Professor for the Section for Thermal Engineering who can strengthen and further develop our activities within electronics cooling, thermal-fluid modelling, and the integration of thermal design considerations into the early development of future technologies. The position includes research, teaching, and collaboration with both internal and external partners, and you will play an active role in shaping new projects together with colleagues in power electronics. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to joint research projects and external funding applications that bridge thermal engineering and power electronics in the design of future power modules.

Your work tasks
As an Assistant Professor in the Section for Thermal Engineering, you will join a strong academic environment where research, teaching, and collaboration with external partners are closely linked. The position is based at the Aalborg campus, and you will be part of an international department working within thermal energy systems, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and related areas. In this position, you will work in close collaboration with researchers in power electronics, in particular Associate Professor Stig Munk Nielsen and colleagues in the power electronics and devices environment. Together, you will contribute to the co-design of new power modules where thermal, electrical, and mechanical aspects are considered on equal footing from the earliest design stages.

Your primary research task will be to develop and carry out research in electronics cooling and thermal-fluid design methods, with a particular focus on supporting decision-making in the early stages of technology and component development. This includes thermal-fluid co-design of devices such as IGBTs, MOSFETs, power modules, and other switching devices, where cooling concepts are integrated as explicit design parameters alongside electrical and electromagnetic performance. You will analyse trade-offs between thermal resistance, temperature gradients, power density, lifetime, and reliability, and contribute to the development of thermal and fluid-dynamic models that can be used early in the development process for screening and optimisation before detailed designs are fixed.

Depending on your background, you may initially focus more strongly on modelling, experiments, or design methodology, and gradually expand your activities towards broader thermal-fluid co-design research.

A central part of your work will be to explore and assess advanced cooling concepts for high-power-density systems. This may include integrated cooling solutions, direct-liquid cooling, and two-phase cooling for very high heat fluxes. You will develop and use Computational Fluid Dynamics models in combination with analytical and reduced-order models, and contribute to publishing research results in international journals and conferences. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to the development of joint research activities and external funding applications together with colleagues from thermal engineering and power electronics.

In parallel with the modelling activities, you will contribute to experimental work at component and module level. This can include development and use of experimental setups for characterisation of thermal resistances and heat fluxes, and validation of cooling concepts at chip, module, and package level. You will work with the interplay between experiments, CFD, and reduced-order models to develop design tools that are sufficiently fast for iterative early-stage development while still capturing the relevant physics.

In teaching, you will contribute to bachelor’s and master’s level courses within thermal engineering, including fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and thermal systems. You will help develop exercises and project activities that draw on realistic engineering problems and demonstrate the interaction between electrical loading, losses, and cooling solutions. You will supervise project and thesis students working on thermal design, cooling concepts, modelling, and experimental investigations. Over time, you are expected to develop a coherent teaching profile linked closely to your research activities and collaborations.

In addition, you will contribute to shared tasks within the section and department, including industry collaboration, study programme development, and supervision of projects associated with externally funded activities.

Your competencies
You have a solid academic background within Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a closely related field, and you hold a PhD degree that qualifies you to work independently with research and research-based teaching.

We recognise that strong candidates may not fulfil every aspect of the profile. Applicants with a strong background in thermal engineering, thermal-fluid modelling, simulation-driven design, or technology development are encouraged to apply, provided they are motivated to further develop competences in electronics cooling and interdisciplinary research.

It is essential that you can document strong competences in flow simulations and thermal modelling, including model development. You have experience using Computational Fluid Dynamics and thermal models as tools to support design and development decisions, rather than solely as post-design analysis tools. You are comfortable working with software environments such as Ansys and OpenFOAM and are motivated to further develop and apply these tools in the context of advanced thermal systems and electronic components.

Prior experience within electronics cooling, component design, thermal management, or related technology development activities will be considered an advantage, but applicants from adjacent fields with strong thermal-fluid competences are also encouraged to apply. Experience from research and development activities, either in academia or industry, including participation in technology development projects and collaboration across disciplines, will likewise be considered an advantage.

Experience with experimental methods in thermal and fluid mechanics, including data analysis, uncertainty estimation, and model validation, is desirable. Familiarity with optical measurement techniques in fluid mechanics and heat transfer will be particularly relevant, as you may contribute to laboratory teaching and research activities.

You are able to reason across scales, from components to systems, and you understand when models must be highly detailed and when lightweight approaches are needed to support efficient development processes.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and orally, and are willing to engage with students, colleagues, and external partners in an international environment. Since part of the teaching and industrial collaboration takes place in Danish, you are expected to be able to supervise students in Danish within two years of employment.

As a colleague, you are motivated by interdisciplinary collaboration and enjoy working at the interface between different engineering disciplines, where modelling, experiments, and design considerations must be integrated to develop effective solutions. You bring strong analytical skills, an interest in both modelling and experiments, and a collaborative mindset. You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and contribute positively to the academic environment.

Who we are
AAU Energy is an research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges. 

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems. 

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues. 

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.  

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support  

Qualification requirements 
Appointment as assistant professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level. The research potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment.

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, The Faculty of Engineering and Science and The Faculty of Medicine. 
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

 Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (in Danish). 

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (only in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (only in Danish). 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Assistant, Tenure-Track Assistant, and Associate Professorships in Software Engineering and Software Technology
description:
SDU Centre for Software Technology in Vejle, part of the Software Engineering units at SDU situated at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invite applications for one or more positions within software engineering and software technology. The positions are open from beginning of 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

The application deadline is September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

What we offer

With a position at SDU, you will:

  • be part of one of our dynamic research centres with both a national and international profile, while working in areas of tremendous potential and societal relevance;

  • join collaborations across the university, as well as with national, international, and industrial research partners;

  • help establish joint innovation projects in close collaboration with industry and the local society;

  • help build up the research and educational environment;

  • contribute to the teaching programmes in Software Engineering at the highest level for undergraduate and graduate students at SDU;

  • join a harmonious workplace environment that is conducive to productivity, promotes creativity, and rewards and recognizes individuals and group achievement;

  • have the opportunity to live and work in one of the happiest countries in the world that also offers excellent and free health and education systems.

 

What we expect

The focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is research and education in software engineering, interactive technology and artificial intelligence. We see these areas complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. We are particularly interested in software operated in real life, systems that adapt at runtime, span embedded devices, edge infrastructure and the cloud, that people work with and trust, and that increasingly answer to regulation. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The positions are open in any of the software engineering and software technology research areas of interest to the centres, which include:

  • AI for Software Engineering and Software Engineering for AI

  • Software Architecture and Design, including Architecting for AI Systems and AI-assisted Architecting

  • LLM-based, Agentic, and Multi-agent Software Systems

  • Human-AI collaboration in Software Development

  • Software Engineering for Physical AI and Embodied Systems

  • Self-Adaptive and Autonomous Software Systems

  • AI Orchestration and Infrastructure for AI Compute Offloading

  • Software Engineering for Embedded, Cyber-Physical and IoT-Edge-Cloud Systems

  • Governance, Compliance and Accountability of AI-Enabled Software

  • Human-Centred and Socio-Technical Software Engineering

  • Software Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Software Operation, Evolution, Maintenance, Recovery and Modernization

  • Software Reliability Engineering

  • Empirical Software Engineering

  • Requirements Engineering, Specification, and Modelling

 

Who we are looking for

We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated research excellence appropriate to their career stage, who show a clear path towards an independent and internationally recognised research programme, and who are able and willing to contribute to competitive national and international funding applications. We also expect an interest in working across disciplines, in supervising students and junior researchers, and in teaching and advising in software engineering at all levels.

We expect applicants to hold a PhD in software engineering, computer science or a closely related discipline, completed before the application deadline. 

For the tenure-track assistant professor positions we expect at least one year of research experience beyond the PhD, gained in academia, at a research institute or in industry. Applicants must demonstrate a higher level of achievement in research and related professional activities than generally expected of assistant professor applicants, as well as the potential to attain international research excellence within their field and meet the criteria for employment as an associate professor during the tenure track assistant professorship. 

For the associate professor positions we expect a research and teaching record corresponding to several years of independent work after the PhD, including documented teaching and supervision experience.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who publish in leading venues in the field, such as ICSE, FSE, ASE, ICSA, ECSA, MLSys, DATE, RE, SEAMS, ICSME, SANER, MODELS, ESEM, ICPE and CAiSE, EICS; and in journals such as TSE, TOSEM, EMSE, JSS, IST and IEEE Software.

Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a requirement, and successful applicants will be offered Danish language courses.

 

Workplace description

The University of Southern Denmark

The University of Southern Denmark is one of the youngest universities in Denmark, founded in 1966. The university is founded around the goal of providing the right knowledge at the right time to support society. The university targets major, complex societal problems of a cross-disciplinary nature such as climate, welfare, health and technology, tackling these in collaboration across faculties.

The Faculty of Engineering

The Faculty of Engineering is driven by the urge to create value for and with society, by curiosity and by the will to create that which only a few could imagine would be possible. Through research, education and collaboration, it is the ambition of the faculty to nurture talent, address challenges, create possibilities, and promote sustainable development. The faculty is strongly engaged with national and international industries and organizations over a broad range of technical domains.

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The department is the 2nd largest department at SDU, with more than 230 staff members and 1500 students. The institute has over the last decades expanded its activities in interactive technologies, artificial intelligence, and software engineering including building several strong research centres at the SDU campuses in Odense and Sønderborg and with the new centre also in Vejle. Thereby, the institute today covers a wide range of areas in robotics, software, AI, and applied informatics.

 

Curious?

If you are interested in learning more about the position, please contact:

  • Torben Worm (Head of Centres): tow@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard (Vice-Head of Centres): mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mahyar Tourchi Moghaddam (Associate Professor): mtmo@mmmi.sdu.dk

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application procedure

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Cover letter.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original and official English translation).

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Up to five most relevant publications to the position.

  • A research statement.

  • For assistant professor applicants: Summary and documentation of experience in teaching

  • For associate professor applicants: Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Up to three reference letters may be included (optional).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included (optional).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Tenure Track at the Faculty of Engineering, SDU
The Faculty of Engineering at SDU offers an attractive tenure track programme aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area.

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  

This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities.

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. 

Appointment as a tenure track assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 4-year period, with guaranteed assessment for a permanent position as associate professor during the final year of employment.

Appointment as an associate professor is permanent.

Employment requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment, as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position level. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, tenure track assistant professor, or associate professor as described therein. 

During employment at assistant professor level (incl. tenure track), the candidate will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

title: Experienced Welder / Tack Welder for Weekend Day Shift
description:
Do you have solid experience in welding and tack welding, and do you thrive in a structured environment with clear expectations and a strong focus on quality and precision? At Give Steel A/S, you will become an important part of our weekend day shift production team, where your contribution helps ensure strong, documented steel structures.

Why Choose Us?

You will become part of a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company with a strong focus on quality, safety, and responsible production. We are committed to employee development and offer a workplace with freedom under responsibility, well-organised working conditions, and opportunities for professional growth.

You will be employed under the Danish Collective Agreement for the Industry Sector (Industriens Overenskomst). In addition, we offer private health insurance and the option to join our canteen scheme.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will join a team manufacturing load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. The work is carried out on the weekend day shift, where you will follow established work procedures and contribute to ensuring tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard of quality.

Your working hours will be from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Tack welding and welding steel structures based on technical drawings and work instructions
  • Preparing components and checking measurements, fit, and quality
  • Carrying out tasks with a systematic and thorough approach
  • Contributing to strong teamwork with colleagues in production
  • Complying with all applicable safety, quality, and documentation requirements

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced and reliable employee who works in a structured and detail-oriented manner. You thrive in a well-defined environment, can maintain an overview in a busy production setting, and take pride in delivering lasting, high-quality results.

We expect that you:

  • Have solid experience as a welder and/or tack welder
  • Work thoroughly, responsibly, and with a strong focus on quality
  • Can read and understand technical drawings
  • Are reliable and a team player
  • Contribute positively to a professional and safe working environment
  • Speak Danish and/or English
  • Live in Denmark within a reasonable commuting distance of Brande

We can provide certification in various welding methods, so it is not important whether you already hold welding certificates.

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Head of Production, Tomas Slepavicius, at tsl@givesteel.com.

We would like to receive your CV, clearly outlining your relevant experience. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and we will remove the job advertisement once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company that develops, designs, manufactures, and erects load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. Quality, safety, and documentation are an integral part of our daily operations, while we also maintain a strong focus on CO₂ reduction and responsible production.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our daily work.

title: Steel Fitters Wanted

We are looking for:

Steel Fitters

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

 Your key responsibilities & duties will include:

·         Blueprint Interpretation: Study engineering drawings, blueprints, and material lists to plan the sequence of tasks and determine material requirements.

·         Layout and Fabrication: Layout reference points and patterns on heavy metal to prepare for cutting, bending, and forming.

·         Assembly and Fitting: Assemble, align, and fit metal sections and plates to form complete units or subunits, using tack welding, bolting, or riveting.

·         Machine Operation: Operate heavy-duty machinery such as cranes, shearers, brake presses, grinders, drills, and cutting torches to prepare components.

·         Quality Inspection: Inspect and test completed components to ensure they meet specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations.

·         Positioning and Installation: Position parts in jigs (sometimes created by tack-welding scrap metal) and use grinders, chisels, or files to ensure precise fits.

Skills:

·     English - must be able to communicate in English 

·         Technical Knowledge: Proficient in reading blueprints and technical drawings.

·         Fabrication Skills: Experience (good to have) with metal fabrication techniques, including tack welding, oxy-acetylene cutting, and operating shop machinery.

·         Mathematical Skills: Strong understanding of shop math for measuring, layout, and calculations.

·         Physical Demands: Ability to perform physically demanding work, including standing for long periods, bending, lifting heavy loads, and sometimes working at heights.

·         Safety Adherence: Strict compliance with occupational health and safety (OHS) standards and proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

title: Elternzeitvertretung/barselsvikar für/til Kulturvereinbarung/Kulturaftale Sønderjylland-Schleswig (Kulturmanager/in)
description:
Elternzeitvertretung für die Kulturvereinbarung Sønderjylland-Schleswig

Möchten Sie Kulturaktivitäten mit entwickeln und umsetzen, die Kinder, Jugendliche und Erwachsene über die deutsch-dänische Grenze hinweg zusammenbringen?

Ein vielseitiger deutsch-dänischer Arbeitsplatz sucht eine engagierte Projektmitarbeiterin bzw. einen engagierten Projektmitarbeiter für eine Elternzeitvertretung ab dem 1. November 2026. Ihre Aufgaben liegen überwiegend im Bereich der Aktivitäten der Kulturvereinbarung Sønderjylland-Schleswig.

Die Kulturvereinbarung wurde zwischen dem Kreis Schleswig-Flensburg, dem Kreis Nordfriesland, der Stadt Flensburg, der Haderslev Kommune, der Aabenraa Kommune, der Tønder Kommune, der Sønderborg Kommune, der Region Syddanmark und dem Land Schleswig-Holstein geschlossen.

Die Umsetzung der Kulturvereinbarung wird durch eine Förderung des dänischen Kulturministeriums unterstützt. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Stärkung kultureller Gemeinschaften und des Wohlbefindens, die Förderung von Demokratie und gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe in der Grenzregion sowie die Unterstützung von Begegnungen und Kooperationen über die Grenze hinweg.

Sie werden beim Regionskontor & Infocenter angestellt und Teil des Teams für Kultur, Sprache und bürgernahe Aktivitäten. Durch Ihre unterschiedlichen Aufgaben arbeiten Sie eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen auf beiden Seiten der Grenze, Kulturschaffenden, Schulen, Kindergärten und weiteren Kooperationspartnern zusammen.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

•  Mitwirkung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung eines deutsch-dänischen Kindertheaterstücks

•  Planung und Durchführung eines Projekts für Schülerinnen und Schüler zu den Herausforderungen des Klimawandels und Möglichkeiten des Klimaschutzes aus der Perspektive von Kindern

•  Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung deutsch-dänischer Demokratiecamps und Demokratiesalons

•  Planung und Koordination deutsch-dänischer Begegnungen und Erfahrungsaustausche

•  Kommunikation und Vermittlung der Aktivitäten der Kulturvereinbarung

•  Unterstützung bei den weiteren Aufgaben des Teams im abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsalltag.

Wir legen Wert darauf, dass Sie:

•  über eine relevante Ausbildung bzw. einen relevanten Studienabschluss verfügen

•  sowohl Dänisch als auch Deutsch so gut beherrschen, dass Sie sich mündlich und schriftlich sicher und problemlos in beiden Sprachen verständigen können

•  Erfahrung mit der grenzüberschreitenden Zusammenarbeit haben oder sich dafür interessieren

•  auf Netzwerke im Kultur- und Freizeitbereich in Dänemark und Deutschland zurückgreifen

können

•  Erfahrung in der Projektarbeit haben und effizient und strukturiert arbeiten

•  gerne in interdisziplinären Teams arbeiten und aktiv dazu beitragen, Lösungen zu finden, wenn Plan A nicht funktioniert.

Es wird erwartet, dass Sie Ihre Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten können, da auch Abend- und Wochenendtermine stattfinden. Ein Führerschein der Klasse B wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir bieten:

•  eine spannende und eigenverantwortliche Tätigkeit mit konkreten Projektaktivitäten

•  die Möglichkeit, sich mit Themen wie Lebensqualität, Gemeinschaft, Demokratie und gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe in einem deutsch-dänischen Kontext zu beschäftigen

•  eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kulturverwaltungen und Kulturschaffenden auf beiden Seiten der Grenze

•  flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten. Montag und Dienstag sind feste Präsenztage.

Ihr Arbeitsplatz befindet sich am Regionskontor & Infocenter, Lyren 1, 6330 Padborg, etwa 10 km von der Grenze entfernt. Sie sollten jedoch damit rechnen, an Sitzungen und Aktivitäten in der gesamten Region Sønderjylland-Schleswig teilzunehmen.

Vergütung und Beschäftigungsbedingungen

Es handelt sich um eine Elternzeitvertretung vom 1. November 2026 bis voraussichtlich zum 31.Oktober 2027 mit einer wöchentlichen Arbeitszeit von 26 Stunden. Die Beschäftigung steht unterdem Vorbehalt möglicher Änderungen des Budgets.

Die Vergütung und Beschäftigungsbedingungen richten sich nach dem geltenden Tarifvertrag.

Bewerbungsgespräche

Bewerbungsfrist: 17. September 2026

Bewerbungsgespräche: 23. September 2026

Arbeitsbeginn: 1. November 2026

Weitere Fragen

Wenn Sie Fragen zur Stelle haben, können Sie sich gerne an uns wenden:

Regionskontor & Infocenter

Leiter Peter Hansen, +45 74 67 05 01

oder

Teamkoordinatorin Anne-Mette Olsen, +45 20 58 30 34

Bewerbung

Ihre Bewerbung senden Sie bitte über die Website der Aabenraa Kommune:

Barselsvikar til Kulturaftale Sønderjylland-Schleswig

Vil du være med til at udvikle og gennemføre kulturaktiviteter, der bringer børn, unge og voksne sammen på tværs af den dansk-tyske grænse?En alsidig dansk-tysk arbejdsplads søger en engageret projektmedarbejder til et barselsvikariat fra den 1. november 2026. Dine opgaver vil fortrinsvis være aktiviteter under Kulturaftale Sønderjylland-Schleswig.

Kulturaftalen er indgået mellem Kreis Schleswig-Flensburg, Kreis Nordfriesland, Stadt Flensburg, Haderslev Kommune, Aabenraa Kommune, Tønder Kommune, Sønderborg Kommune, Region Syddanmark og delstaten Schleswig-Holstein. Kulturaftalen gennemføres med et tilskud fra det danske kulturministerium. Fokus er på at styrke kulturelle fællesskaber og trivsel, fremme demokrati og medborgerskab i grænselandet samt understøtte møder og samarbejder på tværs af grænsen.

Du bliver ansat på Regionskontor & Infocenter og bliver en del af teamet for kultur, sprog og borgernære aktiviteter. Gennem de forskellige opgaver kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med kollegaer fra begge sider af grænsen, kulturaktører, skoler, børnehaver og andre samarbejdspartnere.

Jobbet vil bl.a. omfatte:

•  At være med til at udvikle og gennemføre en dansk-tysk børneteaterforestilling

•  At stå for et projekt for elever om klimaudfordringer og klimahandling i børnehøjde

•  At være med til at gennemføre dansk-tyske demokraticamps og demokratisaloner

•  At planlægge og koordinere dansk-tyske møder og erfaringsudveksling

•  At formidle kulturaftalens aktiviteter

•  At bidrage til teamets øvrige opgaver og være en hjælpende hånd for kollegaerne i en travl hverdag.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

•  har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund

•  behersker både dansk og tysk så godt, at du mundtligt og skriftligt ubesværet kan kommunikere på begge sprog

•  har erfaring med eller interesse for det grænseoverskridende samarbejde

•  kan trække på netværk inden for kultur- og fritidsområdet i både Danmark og Tyskland

•  har erfaring med projektarbejde og arbejder effektivt og struktureret

•  trives i tværfaglige teams og bidrager aktivt til at finde løsninger, når plan A ikke lykkes.

Det forventes, at du kan tilrettelægge din arbejdstid fleksibelt, da der både vil være aften- og weekendmøder. Det forudsættes, at du har kørekort til personbil.

Vi tilbyder:

•  et spændende og selvstændigt job med konkrete projektaktiviteter

•  mulighed for at arbejde med emner som livskvalitet, fællesskaber, demokrati og medborgerskab i en dansk-tysk kontekst

title: Student Assistant– Cyber Security & Compliance
description:
Want to gain hands-on experience within cyber security and compliance, in critical IT infrastructure?

Join our Infrastructure & Security team and get hands-on experience with vulnerability management, audits, access governance, security reporting, and compliance activities. You'll work alongside experienced specialists and help protect business-critical systems while building valuable real-world skills.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

The Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnet, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centers, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

You can read more about Nordic RCC and the services we deliver on our website https://nordic-rcc.net/ 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant – Cyber Security & Compliance who likes to make a difference!

Job description:

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support the Infrastructure & Security team. The role will work closely with the Cyber Security and Compliance functions, helping maintain governance processes, security operations, reporting, and documentation while gaining practical experience within enterprise IT security and compliance. The position supports activities within vulnerability management, access governance, audits, and security reporting.

Responsibilities:

Security Operations Support

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Assist with endpoint compliance reviews and Intune-related administrative activities.

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Coordinate follow-up with system owners and suppliers regarding security findings.

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Collect, organize, and maintain audit evidence.

  • Support preparation for internal and external audits.

  • Maintain compliance documentation and evidence repositories.

  • Track audit findings and remediation activities.

Access Management & Governance

  • Assist with periodic access reviews.

  • Track completion of access review activities.

  • Help maintain governance processes and security controls documentation.

Documentation & Process Management

  • Update security procedures, standards, and runbooks.

  • Maintain SharePoint-based documentation repositories.

  • Ensure documents are reviewed and updated according to governance requirements.

Requirements:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within IT, Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Structured and detail-oriented approach to work.

  • Strong analytical and documentation skills.

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Excel, and SharePoint is an advantage.

  • Interest in cyber security, governance, risk, and compliance.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note:

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 30/09/2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

If you have any questions, please contact Patrick Frømming, Manager, Infrastructure & Security (PFN@nordic-rcc.net).

The successful candidates will have the opportunity to contribute to the establishment of the newly established Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and to play an active role in the development of the upcoming educational programmes for dentists and dental hygienists.

These positions offer a rare opportunity to influence the development of education, research, and clinical teaching from the very beginning, while joining an ambitious academic community dedicated to excellence, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

About the positions

We are seeking candidates with a broad background in dentistry and an interest in the development of university education.

We welcome applicants with diverse dental competencies and subspecialties, for example within:

  • Cariology and Endodontics

  • Periodontology

  • Prosthodontics

  • Orthodontics

  • Oral Surgery

  • Oral Medicine

  • Paediatric Dentistry

  • Clinical Dentistry in General

  • Preventive Dentistry

  • Digital Dentistry

The decisive factor is not your subspecialty alone, but your commitment to contributing to the development of a modern, research-led education in dentistry.

 

Main responsibilities

 

As part of the establishment and development of the department, you will be expected to contribute actively to:

  • the development of the new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, which are expected to commence in the summer of 2027

  • the planning and development of courses and teaching activities

  • teaching at both undergraduate and graduate levels

  • teaching dentistry and dental hygiene students

  • the development of clinical learning activities, simulation-based training, and competency-based education

  • student assessment and supervision

  • collaboration with clinical instructors, private training clinics, and other external partners

  • the development of the department’s teaching and learning environment

  • the development and implementation of research projects within clinical and preventive dentistry

  • scientific publishing and dissemination of research findings

  • the development of national and international research collaborations

  • securing external research funding and contributing to grant applications

Teaching will be based on evidence-based dentistry and will emphasize the close integration of basic sciences, clinical skills, and patient care.

Research

The department is concurrently establishing the Research Unit APEX, which aims to build strong national and international research environments within clinical and preventive dentistry.

We are therefore seeking candidates with an interest in research and academic development.

To be successful in this position, we expect you:

  • have documented research experience

  • have published scientific articles in peer-reviewed journals

  • are motivated to further develop your own research profile

  • have an interest in interdisciplinary and international collaboration.

The research component of the position will be tailored to the individual candidate’s qualifications and career stage.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

  • hold a degree in Dentistry

  • have obtained a PhD degree

  • hold Danish authorization to practice as a dentist, or meet the requirements for obtaining Danish authorization

  • combine strong clinical competencies with a well-developed scientific and analytical mindset

  • are motivated to contribute actively to the development of a new dental department

  • thrive in an interdisciplinary university environment

  • possess strong collaborative and interpersonal skills.

In addition, the following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • documented teaching experience

  • experience with curriculum development

  • experience supervising students

  • experience from specialist training or other advanced areas of clinical expertise.

For candidates appointed as Assistant Professors, participation in the Lecturer Training Programme (Universitetspædagogikum) is planned as part of the appointment.

 

Appointment to the positions requires academic qualifications at PhD level and in accordance with the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

 

What we offer

You will become part of a growing department with a unique opportunity to make a significant academic and professional impact.

Among other things, we offer:

  • the opportunity to help shape new educational programmes from the ground up

  • a strong research-based university environment

  • close integration of research, clinical practice, and teaching

  • excellent opportunities for academic career development

  • the opportunity to contribute to the establishment and development of the Research Unit APEX

  • an engaged and ambitious collegial environment with a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and innovation.

About the department

The Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) aims to advance and disseminate new knowledge within dentistry through excellent research, research-based education in SDU’s new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, and close collaboration with the healthcare sector.

The Department will educate the next generation of dentists and dental hygienists through research-based teaching, modern simulation and clinical training, and close engagement with the wider healthcare system, supported by a strong international research environment of the highest academic standard.

Our vision is to create a strong, internationally oriented research and educational environment where clinical excellence, evidence-based practice, and interdisciplinary collaboration go hand in hand.

Application deadline

October 19, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Contact

Further information about the position may be obtained from Professor and Head of Research Torben H. Thygesen, tthygesen@health.sdu.dk, +45 22 34 13 64, or Acting Head of Department and Dean Jakob Grauslund jgrauslund@health.sdu.dk, +45 93 50 70 42.

Salary and terms of employment 

The applicants will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as assistant professor or associate professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. 

In addition, a centrally agreed assistant professor or associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application 

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total): 

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma) 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 3 for assistant professors, and 6 associate professors, scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy 

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.   

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Assessment 

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process.  

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.  

Living and working in Denmark 

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.  

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.  

Join us in shaping the future of dentistry

We are seeking ambitious colleagues who wish to contribute to more than teaching alone. We invite dentists with a passion for academic development, research, and education to join us in building a new academic environment and educating the oral healthcare professionals of the future.

Together, we are creating the foundation for Denmark’s newest Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and shaping the future of dental education and research.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Inspector, Private Home Cleaning  - Copenhagen
description:
RengøringsAgenterne ApS is looking for a dedicated inspector for our private home cleaning department

Do you have an eye for detail, and do you thrive in a role where quality and great customer relations go hand in hand? Then you might be our new inspector.

RengøringsAgenterne ApS is a Nordic Swan Ecolabel certified cleaning and property services company based in Kastrup. We have more than 200 employees, run a 100% electric vehicle fleet, and won the Børsen Gazelle award in both 2023 and 2024. We provide cleaning for housing associations, businesses and private customers across Greater Copenhagen – and it is our private customers you will be working with.

About the job

As inspector in our private cleaning department, you will be the link between our customers and our cleaning teams. You will report to the company's owner and managing director and play a central role in making sure quality is spot on every single time.

Your main tasks will be:

•      Quality control – ongoing inspection of completed cleaning in our private customers' homes

•      Quality reports – documentation and follow-up on inspection visits

•      Customer contact and relations – dialogue with customers, handling requests and feedback, and building long-term customer relationships

•      Operational support – hands-on support for the daily operations of the private cleaning department

Other tasks within the scope and responsibility of the position may also occur.

We expect that you

•      Have experience from the cleaning industry, the service industry or a similar role with quality responsibility

•      Have a sharp eye for detail and high standards for quality

•      Are outgoing and service-minded and enjoy daily customer contact

•      Communicate confidently in Danish, both spoken and written, including for reporting

•      Work in a structured and independent way and can plan your own day

•      Hold a category B driving licence, as the working day involves driving between customers

Experience with quality control or inspection work is an advantage, but not a requirement.

We offer

•      A full-time position of 40 hours per week with a fixed monthly salary

•      Employment as a salaried employee (funktionær) under proper terms – any overtime is compensated with time off in lieu at a 1:1 ratio

•      Health insurance paid by the company

•      A company car for work use by agreement, and work clothing where the position requires it

•      An informal and busy working day in a growing company with short decision-making paths

•      Green values in practice: Nordic Swan Ecolabel certification and an electric vehicle fleet

Practical information

•      Workplace: Fuglebækvej 3D, 2770 Kastrup – with daily driving to customers across Greater Copenhagen

•      Working hours: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday between 8:00 and 17:00 (Friday until 16:30)

•      Start date: As soon as possible, or by agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV via Jobnet or to privat@ren-agenterne.dk. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate – so send your application today.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to write to us at privat@ren-agenterne.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Customer Success - Support & Training Specialist
employer: BTR Personnel services AB, filial af BTR Personnel services AB, Sverige
description:
Position Overview: We are seeking a full-time Support & Training Specialist based in Copenhagen, Denmark. In this role, you will provide front-line technical assistance, software guidance, and application training to users of our clinical trial technology platform. Your primary responsibilities will focus on resolving user software inquiries, handling application data change requests, creating end-user documentation, and guiding platform onboarding. This role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to technical troubleshooting.

We are looking for candidates who are detail-oriented, responsive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Ideal candidates will demonstrate a passion for customer service, the ability to execute tasks with precision, and excellent communication and documentation skills.

What You’ll Do:

● User Application Support: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for software users across Europe and globally, diagnosing and resolving application usage questions via ticket or email.

● System & Data Management: Process application data change requests with accuracy, verifying data integrity within the platform.

● User Onboarding & Training: Conduct virtual application walkthroughs and training sessions to ensure platform users understand system functionality and protocol-specific workflows.

● Technical Documentation: Create, update, and maintain user-facing help guides, application FAQs, training manuals, and application release notes.

● Incident Logging & Escalation: Track, document, and reproduce technical software issues reported by users, escalating system bugs to internal engineering teams when necessary.

● Quality Assurance: Verify system functionality post-updates and contribute to feedback loops for software usability improvements.

 

 What You’ll Need:

● Strong interest in user support, software training, or technical help desk functions.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain software features clearly to non-technical users.

● High attention to detail and strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

● Ability to manage incoming support tickets effectively in a fast-paced environment.

● Experience creating software documentation, user guides, or training materials.

● Bachelor’s Degree preferred.

title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.


Your profile & qualifications
You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.
You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Senior RF Systems & Hardware Engineer – Coherent RF Architecture
description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems & Hardware Engineer to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.


Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
  • Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
  • Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
  • Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
  • Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
  • Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
  • Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
  • Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
  • Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.


Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
  • Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
  • Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
  • Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
  • Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
  • Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
  • Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.


Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

title: DSP Engineer - RF Sensing & Geolocation
description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced Digital Signal Processing Engineer to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will predominantly involve designing and implementing DSP algorithms for signal classification, interference detection, signal deinterleaving, and geo-localisation within Software Defined Radio (SDR) systems.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with RF, software, embedded, FPGA, and product teams, with your primary focus being to develop and validate DSP algorithms that improve sensing performance, robustness, and product quality across defense use cases.


Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, validate, and mature DSP algorithms that improve the performance, robustness, and quality of Quadsat’s RF sensing and geolocation capabilities.

  • Design, prototype, and validate DSP algorithms for RF signal classification, interference detection, demodulation, signal analysis, and geo-localization within Software Defined Radio (SDR) systems.
  • Develop algorithm concepts, reference implementations, and validation tools in Python, MATLAB, or similar technical computing environments.
  • Work with recorded and live RF data to evaluate algorithm performance, identify limitations, and improve robustness under real-world conditions such as noise, interference, multipath, calibration errors, and synchronization effects.
  • Contribute to direction finding and RF sensing capabilities, including methods such as AoA, TDOA, interferometry, monopulse processing, beamforming, tracking, and related estimation techniques.
  • Define test methods, performance metrics, and acceptance criteria for DSP algorithms, including accuracy, sensitivity, stability, robustness, and failure modes.
  • Collaborate with software, embedded, FPGA, and RF engineers to support the transition of validated algorithms into product-ready implementations.
  • Provide technical leadership within DSP and RF sensing, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s algorithm development, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.


Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in DSP development for RF, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, or other advanced sensing systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience developing and validating DSP algorithms on real RF data.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with digital signal processing for RF and Software Defined Radio systems.
  • Proven ability to develop, prototype, and validate DSP algorithms in Python, MATLAB, or similar technical computing environments.
  • Experience working with real RF measurement data, including noisy or imperfect data from SDRs, radar, EW, SATCOM, telecom, or related systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF signal chains, including sampling, bandwidth, filtering, SNR, synchronization, phase, and calibration effects.
  • Experience with signal detection, classification, interference analysis, signal characterization, or geolocation-related signal processing.
  • Experience with direction finding or RF sensing techniques such as AoA, TDOA, interferometry, monopulse processing, beamforming, triangulation, tracking, or related estimation methods.
  • Ability to define validation methods, performance metrics, test cases, and acceptance criteria for DSP algorithms.
  • Familiarity with SDR platforms and practical deployment constraints such as real-time processing, data throughput, latency, synchronization, and hardware limitations.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while collaborating closely with RF, software, embedded, FPGA, robotics, and product teams.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar development, SIGINT, RF surveillance, coherent multi-channel RF systems, C/C++ implementation, FPGA-based DSP, embedded DSP, fixed-point processing, CUDA, VHDL, Verilog, calibration, or transitioning algorithms from prototype into operational products.


Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

title: Senior auto mechanic / technician
description:

Would you like to become part of a modern, fully electric vehicle workshop where professional development, teamwork and fleet operational stability are the focus? Then you might be the person we're looking for at our workshop at GreenMobility in Rødovre!

Professionalism, quality and development

At GreenMobility, we are looking for a skilled senior technician/automechanic who, together with the rest of the workshop team, will ensure high quality in the daily work and contribute to the best possible operational stability for our fleet of 1,400 electric cars in Copenhagen.

You will become part of a professional workshop where we work exclusively with electric vehicles, modern technology and ongoing skills development. If you are earlier in your career, we will provide thorough training and sparring from experienced colleagues.

Your primary tasks will include:

  • Maintenance and repair of passenger cars (fully electric), including motors, gearboxes, brakes, suspension and coupling systems

  • Fault-finding and diagnosis of error codes using OEM and third-party diagnostic tools

  • Identifying and repairing faults on electric motors

  • Servicing and repairing AC pumps and climate systems

  • Carrying out routine inspections and preventive maintenance to minimise fleet downtime

  • Accurate documentation of all repairs, parts used and diagnostic results in the workshop system

We imagine that you:

  • Are a trained passenger car mechanic or have an equivalent technical background

  • Work independently, in a structured and quality-conscious manner

  • Have an interest in new technology, modern vehicle systems and electric cars

  • Focus on delivering high quality and doing the job right the first time
